_note: Corrections already reviewed in blunder-busting — excluded from fresh work in tune.py and /blunder-buster (so each round surfaces only NEW patterns). Hand-editable; append with tools/train/review_correction.py. Key = '<episode_id>-<frame>' (the id the reports print). disposition: 'refuted' (a bad correction, e.g. it forgoes a Knock Out — also dropped from the weight fit), 'deferred' (valid but needs new infrastructure), 'covered' (already handled by an existing rule). Keys starting with '_' are comments. NB keyed by decision (episode+frame), so a conflicting re-tag of the same decision is covered by one entry. DESIGN: this is a SET-ASIDES ledger — it lists ONLY corrections held off fresh work by human judgment. Corrections satisfied by a shipped rule, and tactical / no-obs skips, are handled automatically by the tuner and are intentionally NOT listed here — which is why this file stays small even after a whole build has been reviewed (see _reviewed_builds).
